header: Computes how much of an employee's travel expenses the company refunds per receipt, and runs the expense claim through approval to payment.

S1.text: Money in whole cents: integer arithmetic keeps sums exact, and percentages round down.

S1.before: static int minusFloored(int cents, int that) { return Math.max(cents - that, 0); }
S1.text: Subtraction never goes negative: a deduction can at most cancel the amount.
Picks the refund rule by expense kind: meal, lodging, mileage; every other kind counts as hospitality.
Meals are refunded as spent, but at most the per-person limit times the number of persons.
Hotel stays: the breakfast price per night is deducted first; the room price is capped at the per-night limit.
Private car: paid per kilometre, not by receipt. The first 200 km get the full rate, every further km 60 % of it.
Business entertainment: 70 % of the gross amount is refundable, independent of quantity.
Receipts older than 90 days are refunded with nothing; otherwise the category rule decides.
